description: This Java class 'EntityFieldValue' represents a field value expression used in entity conditions within the Apache OFBiz framework. It provides methods for initializing, resetting, and generating SQL snippets for entity fields, supporting view entities and aliasing.

classes.name: EntityFieldValue
classes.description: Represents a field value in entity conditions, supporting aliasing and view entities, with methods for SQL generation and validation.

methods.name: makeFieldValue
methods.description: Creates an EntityFieldValue instance with a specified field name.

methods.name: makeFieldValue
methods.description: Creates an EntityFieldValue with specified field name, entity alias, alias stack, and view entity.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the EntityFieldValue with field name, entity alias, alias stack, and view entity.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code based on field name, alias, alias stack, and view entity.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another EntityFieldValue object.

methods.name: getModelField
methods.description: Retrieves the ModelField corresponding to this entity field, considering view entities and aliases.

methods.name: setModelField
methods.description: Stub method for setting the model field; logs info.

methods.name: addSqlValue
methods.description: Generates SQL snippet for the entity field, supporting view entities and aliasing.

methods.name: validateSql
methods.description: Validates that the field exists in the given model entity.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of the field from a given map or entity.

methods.name: freeze
methods.description: Returns this object as an immutable representation.
